# Hsepid.np

> Hsepid.np is a Nepal-based brand with two parts: Hsepid Optical (sunglasses, power glasses and eye-care from two physical optical stores in Kathmandu, plus an online store on Daraz) and Hsepid Tech (web apps, AI tools and interactive experiences). Founded by Dipesh Kharel.

## Main page
- [Hsepid.np home](https://YOUR-SITE-URL/): intro, optical stores, Hsepid Tech projects, about, contact (English, Nepali, Hindi, Bengali, Spanish, French, Arabic, Chinese)

## Hsepid Optical — physical stores
Location: Jadibuti, Narephat, near BP Eye Hospital, Kathmandu, Nepal.
- Shreekunja Optical — phone/WhatsApp +977 9841623999 — https://shreekunja-optical.vercel.app
- Radhakrishna Optical — phone/WhatsApp +977 9741889699

## Hsepid Tech — projects
- [Truth or Dare](https://letsplaytruthordare.vercel.app): multiplayer Nepali Truth or Dare game with a lie detector
- [NEXUS](https://nexus144.vercel.app): AI-powered education platform
- [Aivoke.Ai](https://aivokeai.vercel.app): AI assistant and automation platform
- [Personal AI](https://personal-ai14.vercel.app): personal AI chat assistant
- [Shreekunja Optical](https://shreekunja-optical.vercel.app): catalog and billing site for an optical shop
- [Gita Prabhav](https://gita-prabhav14.vercel.app): devotional site themed around the Gita
- [BANTBHA](https://bantbha.vercel.app): community utility web app
- Full list of projects is on the home page.
